salary.rule: Floors are monthly PKR; foreign salaries converted via FX table.

experience_filter.rule: Apply to ANY job related to the target fields regardless of required experience - junior, mid, or senior. Seniority is never a filter, penalty, or boost.

matching.note: Every application waits for user approval in Gmail drafts (user sends manually).

auto.note: Jobs without an employer email go to the browser-assist queue (Week 2 layer), never auto-drafted to a guessed address.

ats_companies.note: 4th source = direct company career pages. Add target companies here; unknown board tokens are skipped automatically.

smartrecruiters.note: verified: gameloft lists 50 public postings; spotify board exposes 0. Add target companies anytime.

recruitee.note: adapter ready; add company subdomains to enable

workable.note: v3 API needs signed payload - roadmap

adzuna.note: self-gates on ADZUNA_APP_ID/KEY env (GitHub Secret); pk + us searches

jooble.note: self-gates on JOOBLE_API_KEY env; Pakistan search

themuse.note: self-gates on THEMUSE_API_KEY env (key optional, raises limits)

jsearch.note: self-gates on JSEARCH_API_KEY env; read-window into LinkedIn/Indeed/Glassdoor/Rozee listings

gmail_job_alerts_inbox.note: read official LinkedIn/Indeed/Glassdoor alert emails from your Gmail - safe

linkedin_indeed_glassdoor_browse.note: Week-2 browser-assist layer, see INTEGRATIONS.md safety playbook

linkedin_browse.note: safe browser layer built; enable after one-time login: python browser/session.py --login linkedin

indeed_browse.note: safe browser layer built; enable after one-time login: python browser/session.py --login indeed

glassdoor_browse.note: safe browser layer built; enable after one-time login: python browser/session.py --login glassdoor

wellfound_browse.note: safe browser layer; enable after one-time login: python browser/session.py --login wellfound. Tier-4 priority source: startup/AI roles, salary often listed in card.

wats.note: YC Work at a Startup - THE startup source; 30 freshest YC jobs per run with salary + batch info

rozee_browse.note: Rozee CAPTCHA-challenges automated browsers (verified 2026-09-29). We never bypass challenges. Options: JSearch free key covers Rozee listings via Google Jobs; or assisted browsing with the user present. Flip enabled:true only if daily graceful skips are acceptable.

browser_layer.note: SITES NEED ONE-TIME MANUAL LOGIN: python browser/session.py --login all. Password never stored; session cookies live only in browser/chrome_profile/ (gitignored).
